content:
Apple has set up a Siri AI waitlist for beta users of the upcoming operating system, and it looks like the same approach will continue when iOS 27 and macOS 27 officially launch next month.

That means after your device updates to the new operating system, you won't be able to use the new Siri AI features right away...

Apple added the Siri AI waitlist in the first developer beta of iOS 27 and macOS 27. This is likely done to evaluate usage and determine how much server capacity is needed to handle AI tasks that cannot be executed on-device.

The waiting time for beta users varies, with many saying it's roughly one to two weeks. During the wait, the Siri AI settings will only show "Joined Waitlist".

It looks like the Siri AI waitlist will continue in the official version of the new operating system. A MacRumors forum member discovered that Apple just added a piece of code to estimate how long users might have to wait.

The wait time estimate is provided by the server, meaning Apple can adjust the wait time based on the balance of demand and capacity.

When you are granted access to these new features, you will receive a push notification.
